info.title: AnyLink Protocol
info.description: Harness-independent Personal Agent Network protocol. Cloud Hub provides multi-model gateway with SSE disconnect recovery, Cloud Memory Brain (hybrid retrieval, serialized consolidation, startup recovery, automatic device-boundary learning), binary cross-device artifacts, and real-time WebSocket task bus (/edge/v1/ws) with heartbeat fencing, monotonic event cursors, receipt acknowledgements, queue priorities, loop guards, and interactive suspend/reply.
